claims.claim: An otherwise valid CODE_FIX REPAIR is dispatched to its selected Executor exactly once even when predecessor reusable-candidate state is malformed, incomplete, wrong-subject, changed-files-inconsistent, or otherwise unusable solely for verification-only package reuse.

CODE_FIX is not rejected by local-versus-transported reusable-candidate equality or reusable package completeness/acceptance checks, while exact canonical FAILURE, TASK, failed_head_sha, REPAIR, correction-lineage, and historical-admission gates remain enforced independently.

A genuinely eligible NO_CHANGE verification-only reuse request still fails closed before canonical verification when its reusable state is malformed, conflicting, wrong-RUN, wrong-TASK/revision, wrong-subject, changed-files-inconsistent, incomplete, or lacks complete TASK acceptance coverage, without Executor fallback, retry, or reroute.
Existing valid qualifying NO_CHANGE reuse remains zero-Executor and executes the canonical TASK verification list exactly once through the existing Runtime completion boundary.

A full deterministic continuation regression models PRIMARY canonical verification failure followed by an eligible NO_CHANGE continuation whose canonical verification also fails, followed by an authorized CODE_FIX REPAIR that dispatches normally exactly once and remains bound to the exact failed_head_sha and continuation/root lineage produced by the second verification failure.

The CODE_FIX final candidate in the continuation topology is processed by existing REPAIR repository, completion, and verification gates without substituting any reusable package for the Executor result.

Existing historical REPAIR recovery, current-HEAD REPAIR, no-retry/no-fallback/no-reroute behavior, exactly-one ordinary Executor dispatch, Runtime-owned verification/EVIDENCE, and immutable artifact schemas remain behaviorally unchanged outside the corrected reusable-state authority ordering.

No worker, adapter, dispatcher, downstream repository, roadmap capability status, or publication surface changes were made; the implementation is strictly limited to the Runtime/Operator reuse decision boundary and focused deterministic regression coverage.
